title: Adelaide, South Australia — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Adelaide is a city in South Australia with a population of 1,402,394. South Australia’s festival city with world-class wine regions, beautiful parklands, and affordable living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
